# FraudInsurance.co.nz — LLMs Context File
# New Zealand's guide to personal and business fraud protection insurance
# Updated: May 2026

## Site Overview
FraudInsurance.co.nz is an independent New Zealand information and referral service covering personal fraud protection and business fraud insurance. The site covers personal fraud types (identity theft, card fraud, online scams, account takeover, investment scams) and business insurance (commercial crime, fidelity, cyber, social engineering, and funds transfer fraud). Business enquiries are referred to licensed NZ insurance advisers.

## Key Statistics (2025)
- NZ fraud losses 2025: $3 billion (30% increase from 2024)
- NZ adults who encounter scams weekly: 82%
- NZ adults who lost money to scams: 23%
- Recovery rate (reported to bank): 36%
- Average individual loss: $3,352
Source: Netsafe / GASA NZ Scam Report 2025

## Key Business Providers
- Chubb NZ: FraudProtector (commercial crime, internal + external fraud)
- DUAL NZ: Cyber insurance with social engineering endorsement (up to $250k sublimit)
- NZI: Cyber Base and Cyber Ultra products
- Delta Insurance NZ: Cyber Liability up to $10m
- Marsh NZ: Commercial crime and cyber broker
- Rothbury Insurance Brokers: Fidelity insurance broker
- Unite Insurance: Fidelity insurance broker
- AIG NZ: Commercial crime and cyber insurance

## Important Disclaimers
- FraudInsurance.co.nz is an information and referral service only
- Not a licensed insurer or financial adviser
- Business enquiries referred to licensed NZ insurance advisers
- Personal protection section links directly to providers and free services
- All insurance advice should be confirmed with a licensed professional
